description: Accounts arranged according to parshiyot and months. Dating: probably 18th- or 19th-century based on the paleography. A variety of names are mentioned, such as: Moshe Manṣūrī, Shelomo Delmar, Shemuʾel Ḥanān, Moshe רכז(?), Av[raham] Dayyan, Yiṣḥaq Levi Grbū.[...]. A more concrete dating estimate may be possible through further research into the names mentioned. MCD.
description_he: חשבונות מאוחרים מסודרים לפי פרשיות וחודשים.
